But I've another request, if you're willing. \nAs you know, I'm a smith with lofty standards for craft and materials. I used to have suppliers providing rarity stock, but the mongrels have turned to peddling their wares in the black market as of late. This leaves me in a bind, as I've urgent orders to fill. I'll not have my family's name sullied by pawning off shoddy work forged from scrap metal! \nSo I need you to slay the Skeleton Spearmen blocking the road. Do this, and I shall see you compensated handsomely.

Aye, those cursed Skeleton archers have been a real thorn in my side. Can hardly get close to the blighters with their barrage of arrows. Many thanks again for clearing out the wretched things. \nTheir bones would serve us well for strengthening weapons and armor. \nGather some for me if you're able, and I'll craft you a fine piece of equipment in return, guaranteed to impress!

If you can uncover its whereabouts, you'll have my endless gratitude.

My father, fearing our secrets loose, took me away from Karnas. We never saw Nars again. They say he never returned from those shadowed depths, bearing the blade I forged. I hope you can find him.
